text:
maria gonzalez: CI canary failed perf test seq1024-throughput on int8+fp8 microbatch path. p99 up ~12% vs baseline.
samir patel: ugh. which job failed? link?
ci-runner: [CI] Job 'perf/seq1024-throughput' failed on master
ci-runner: Summary: p50 +3.2%, p95 +6.7%, p99 +12.1% (tokens/sec down)
kevin choi: seeing same locally when running bench harness with --seq=1024 --microbatch=auto
alex weinberg: profiler shows hot functions: dequant_kernel_v2 -> kvcache_lookup -> kernel_selector
maria gonzalez: paste of perf snippet:
```
hotspot  35.2%  dequant_kernel_v2
hotspot  18.4%  kvcache_lookup
hotspot  12.9%  kernel_selector::choose_with_latency_hint
```
kevin choi: bisect yields 7f3a2bc (aos/quant-shim): changed kernel selection threshold to prefer fp8 kernels for small batches
samir patel: that commit also added microbatch coalescing heuristics that ignore kv cache occupancy
june liu: so cold-start kv cache + fp8 selection -> more dequant ops than before? makes sense
maria gonzalez: experiment: revert that commit locally -> p99 back to baseline within noise (~0.5%)
alex weinberg: repro steps I ran:
```
git checkout master && git revert 7f3a2bc && bazel test //bench:perf --config=ci --run_under='bench harness' --bench_args='--seq=1024 --samples=50'
```
ci-runner: perf job re-run on revert candidate shows p99 delta -11.8% (improvement)
kevin choi: root cause: kernel_selector now prefers fp8 kernels for <4 microbatch size even when kv cache miss rate is >60%. fp8 kernel has dequant fallback path that does extra memcpy for streaming path.
samir patel: suggested fix: make selection consider kv_miss_rate AND streaming_flag; fallback to int8 kernel for high kv-miss streaming workloads
maria gonzalez: temp mitigation: hold rollout of canary, revert on master if we don't have fix within next 2hrs :eyes:
alex weinberg: I'll open PR with selection patch + unit tests. plan: add telemetry metric kernel_choice_reason and kv_miss_rate sample in perf CI
june liu: also add microbench that simulates cold kv cache (kv_miss_rate ~0.9) to CI matrix
kevin choi: can we short-circuit dequant when fp8 kernel can produce output directly into user buffer? low-effort patch reduces memcpy and saves ~3-4% p99
maria gonzalez: good. prioritize the kernel selector change first, then memcpy short-circuit as optimization
samir patel: tagging @eng-releases — hold the FP8-dark-launch roll
deploy-bot: Rollout paused for release/quant-fp8-dark-launch by request of eng-runtime
maria gonzalez: I'll coordinate cherry-pick and perf gates. assigning PR to alex
alex weinberg: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/aos/pull/4891 - includes kernel selector patch + new telemetry
kevin choi: running CI perf with new selector patch now
ci-runner: CI perf job queued (matrix includes kv_cold_sim)
maria gonzalez: thanks all. follow-up: if revert needed we do immediate revert + hotfix for select patch. otherwise unblock after perf green. :thumbsup:
